# Relaunch budget

Budget for the website relaunch: agency fees in three instalments, hosting for the new platform, licences for the editing tool and a contingency of ten percent. So far the invoices follow the plan. The first instalment was paid on signature, the second is due at the design review, the third at go-live.

Hosting is the uncertain line, because the traffic estimate comes from last year's analytics. I review the figures every month and report the variance to the steering group.
